typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Fact_Query as string,
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer
}
source(output(
		NetTime as string,
		DW_AGG_KEY as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> FACTDATASRC
FACTDATASRC sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		NetTime = Param_0,
		DW_AGG_KEY = Param_1
	)) ~> OLEDBCommand
